summary.en: Warm paper and one overview diagram of layer bands; only the nodes are hand-drawn (rough outline and hachure), connectors clean, one colour per layer and one per message.
summary.zh: 暖纸上一张分层总图；只有节点是手绘（粗糙轮廓加排线），连线干净，每层一色，每种消息一色。

fits: Explaining how a system works from its map: layers, parts and the messages between them.
notFor: Counts and shares (use paper-ledger); dark technical looks.

intent.en: Let the viewer keep the whole system in view while one part is explained, in a drawing that looks made by hand for them.
intent.zh: 讲一个部分时让观众一直看得到整个系统，画面像专门为他们手画的。

content.en: A system with 3–6 layers of up to six parts each, one layer to zoom into, its parts and the messages of one task.
content.zh: 一个 3–6 层、每层至多 6 个部件的系统，要放大的那一层，它的部件和一次任务里的消息。

fits.zh: 从总图讲一个系统怎么运作：分层、部件和它们之间的消息。

notFor.zh: 计数和比例（用 paper-ledger）；暗色技术风。

en: Only nodes are rough; frames, lines and circles stay clean or the diagram reads as a doodle.
Ochre (mechanism) is 3.83:1 on the paper: names and outlines only, no body text.
zh: 只有节点粗糙；框、线、圆保持干净，否则像涂鸦。
赭色（机制层）在纸上只有 3.83:1：只用于层名和轮廓，不用于正文。

waive.all: an own brick split from teach-video's blueprint-zoom kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)
